d.t: (chiefly among Samoan-Americans) Brother (a male comrade or friend). Similar in use to bro.

d.e: On the High Road and I'm drivin slow with one ucker When I tell her “suck!“, she don't say much, not one stutter.

d.t: A First Nation group based on the west coast of Vancouver Island in British Columbia, Canada, on the northwest side of Barkley Sound.
d.e: Residents of Hitac̓u, the heart of the Ucluelet First Nation, have been told not to drink, bathe in, or even clean with the water coming out of their taps.
